// A view into the Mandelbrot set: the complex-plane center, a dimensionless
// magnification (1 shows roughly the classic 4-unit-wide view; larger values
// show proportionally smaller regions), and the iteration cap.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mandelbrot_set)
type MandelbrotView
    implements IValue
{
    Center: Complex;
    Zoom: Number;
    MaxIterations: Integer;
}
